name: Topstep 50K
source: Account holder 2026-09-27: "the topstep is just like the lucid flex no dll but allows 5 contracts". So every rule is LucidFlex 50K@2026-09-27's -- $3,000 target, $2,000 EOD-trailing max loss with the +$2,100 -> +$100 lock, 50% consistency on top of a 2-day minimum, no daily loss limit, the same payout terms -- except the size cap: 5 minis (50 micros), with no scaling plan. CORRECTED 2026-10-11 from Topstep's pages (https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284208-consistency-at-topstep, https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284204-what-is-the-maximum-loss-limit, https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284233-topstep-payout-policy, https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284223-what-is-the-scaling-plan): the consistency target is 55% (best day over 55% of the profit RAISES the target to best day / 0.55 -- the same test as 'largest day <= 55% of the profit at the pass'), the floor locks at the starting balance ($50,000, not $50,100) once the close reaches +$2,000, the Express Funded Account starts at 2 lots, and the minimum payout is $125. Not yet confirmed by the account holder: "confirmed": false.
payout_ladder: Standard path: 5 winning days of $150+, 50% of the balance up to $2,000 a payout, minimum $125; 90/10 split
notes: Flat by 16:10 ET (3:10 PM Central), no overnight holds. NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning.

Only the FIRST payout is simulated (Standard path). After a payout the floor is set to $0 and the 5-day count restarts: NOT MODELLED. The Consistency path (3 days, largest day <= 40%, cap $3,000) is NOT MODELLED.
Trailing max loss is END OF DAY: the floor moves up with the end-of-day balance and never down, and is enforced in real time (an open loss that touches it liquidates the account).
The floor LOCKS at the starting balance ($50,000) once the close reaches +$2,000. The Express Funded Account starts at $0 with the floor at -$2,000 and locks at $0 the same way.
Consistency 55%: at the pass the best day must be 55% of the total profit or less; a bigger best day raises the target to best day / 0.55, i.e. keep trading. A pass in two days is possible.
Payout (Standard path) requires 5 winning days >= $150 AND net profit > 0. The amount is 50% of the balance up to $2,000 (minimum $125), so the max payout needs >= $4,000 profit.
No daily loss limit by default (an optional $1,000 one can be added at checkout: not this file). No time limit; the Combine is a monthly subscription.
Max size 5 minis = 50 micros in the Combine. The funded account scales: 2 lots under $1,500, 3 lots to $2,000, 5 lots above. NOT enforced by the simulator.
disclaimer: Topstep's published rules as read 2026-10-11; not yet confirmed by the account holder. The 2026-09-27b file was a copy of LucidFlex.
